new_content.name: Sponj
new_content.how_to_obtain: Shapeless: 2 vanilla sponges give 2 sponj. Also obtained by smelting a Wet Sponj or drying one in the Nether.
new_content.notes: Absorbs water in a radius that grows with the number of sponjes touching each other.

new_content.name: Lava Sponj
new_content.notes: Absorbs lava instead of water, with the same connected-count radius scaling.

new_content.name: Wet Sponj
new_content.how_to_obtain: A Sponj that has absorbed water.
new_content.notes: Dries out in the Nether, or can be smelted to return a Sponj.

new_content.name: Wet Lava Sponj
new_content.how_to_obtain: A Lava Sponj that has absorbed lava.
new_content.notes: Dries out in the End. Works as furnace fuel that smelts 128 items and leaves a dry Lava Sponj; insert only one at a time or you will not get the dry sponj back.

mechanics.title: Connected radius
mechanics.description: Touching sponjes combine to enlarge the absorption area.

vanilla_changes.change: 2 sponges -> 2 sponj (shapeless crafting). Vanilla sponge behavior is not otherwise changed.

qol: Reusable, scalable alternative to vanilla sponges for draining water or lava.
getting_started: Craft sponj from vanilla sponges, place it near water, then dry it in the Nether or smelt it to reuse. Add magma cream for lava.
editor_notes: 5 advancements: root 'Soak it all up'; Big Gulp (dry a region with 16+ connected sponjes); Spill Response Team (absorb 100,000 blocks of water in total); Dry Heat (dry a wet sponj in the Nether); Space Heater (dry a wet lava sponj in the End). Smelting recipe: wet sponj -> sponj.
name: Sponj
summary: A sponge variant whose absorption radius grows with the number of connected sponjes. Adds a water-absorbing sponj and a lava-absorbing lava sponj, each with a wet form. The pack author's own mod.
